worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.summary: Slam psychic force into the chosen ground and push an expanding psychic wave out from the point over six ticks, hitting each foe only once; it neither uses nor consumes any terrain. If the user is grounded on a valid psychic terrain (ally or foe), the wave is wider and deals 1.5x power.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.use.1: Borrow a psychic terrain to widen the wave
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.descrip: Deals about %1$s special damage within %2$s blocks of the chosen point; the wave expands outward from the centre over six ticks, hitting each foe only once.
If the user is grounded on a valid psychic terrain (ally or foe), the wave widens to %1$s blocks and deals 1.5x power; the terrain is not consumed.
The wave leaves no residual terrain and slows nobody.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.prefere: Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to spread terrain; when off it stays put.

Counting within 6 blocks of yourself while standing on terrain, or of the landing point on a normal cast: this many enemies raises the cast to a high priority; a higher threshold is harder to trigger.
